meaning:
βδελύσσω, βδελύσσομαι
(βδέω, to stink), [in LXX chiefly for שׁקץ ,תּעב ;]
in cl., mid. only (Attic, -ττομαι); to make foul; pass., Rev.21:8; mid., to turn away in disgust from, to detest: Rom.2:22 (Cremer, 137).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?
But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars, their part is in the lake that burns…
